notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/d72e317e8063c2615602f45a0f4f8dd8eb75150d.jpg[/img]

We wish all of us new exciting Games. Ultimate Games. More kindness. More joy. More strength, for all of us. And more big black plastic bags for the remains of our enemies.…

[h2]What awaits the Morganica project in the New Year 2025?[/h2]

These days, we are preparing to release part of the project on Kickstarter. A demo version of the multiplayer part of the Game is scheduled to be released by the end of February. 10 players will converge in a frenzy of ritual Blood Harvest.

I don't want anyone to feel cheated, and  don't want anyone to think that we're cheaters. What are we doing and what to expect from our current work?

A demo version is being created to be presented to investors and the publishing company. Its gameplay and the mechanics used will be limited. We try to show the main features.

[list]
[*] Multiplayer carnage on the procedurally generated territory of Stomad Prison and CorpseEater Hall.
[*] So far, only 2 out of 10 players will be able to participate in the battle.
[*] Deathmatch Mode.
[*] Regeneration. This is the ability to upgrade your avatar with additional arms, legs, and eyes. With the bonuses resulting from such an upgrade.
[*] The opportunity to call an assistant - a friendly zombie who is ready to help, if the player has a valuable artifact - the Ice mold, so beloved by the undead.
[*] Various interactive location mechanics
[*] VR mode, in addition to the standard one.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/ff3edfdc55e6319f3c946e6f7bdc199a66cbb95a.jpg[/img]

The demo is being developed in our new studio in Belgrade. This year we would like to finish the work on the multiplayer part of the Morganica project and start the singleplayer one. Everything will be decided in the first half of this year. As always, we are confident of success.

We will keep you all informed. Your opinion and your support are very important to us.

And by the way… We have account in Bluesky now, please follow - [url=https://morganicagame.bsky.social]https://morganicagame.bsky.social[/url]

notes.title: WHY MORGANICA IS COOL
notes.content:
Preparing for the release of the project on Kickstarter, we had to seriously think about which part of the entire Project would be announced for development in the first place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/5dc4c1f3a6ee340738bbaff239cbd78bd7d6474c.jpg[/img]

Morganica, which has already taken 4 years to develop, today represents about a terabyte of text, graphics, video and game materials. This is a full-fledged world with its own history, large number of different characters and 12 locations. Each element has its own story. Its own purpose. The game is divided into single-player part and multiplayer. Where to begin?

We will start with the most interesting, in our opinion. From the multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/132c24fe57627bf70d7d7dfdfb65455598c0c044.jpg[/img]

WHAT'S INTERESTING ABOUT MORGANICA MULTIPLAYER

1. Player can hire monster or zombie to help us. Of course, if we have enough ‘Ice’ for this. The bastards would do anything for this green mold. Their appearance at the most intense moment of a battle with ammunition or a first-aid kit is difficult to overestimate. The guys are good at shooting. And it can also be very useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/f98325d3bf56408e0835962243ed0e0d43ac0550.jpg[/img]

2. If Players have lost a limb, one’s eye has been knocked out or our ears have been torn off, they go to the tramp Mad in the store of fresh human corpses of Enik and the dwarf Quig. There Players can buy themselves something to replace lost organs, and if the loot in the inventory allows, then they can sew on a couple of new ones. Who would give up the opportunity to run along walls, see 360 degrees or scan surroundings like a bat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/9914dcd21fe97c614ccee83323869d41f57a702e.jpg[/img]

3. Killer, Bloody Packer, Ripper, The Sacrificer, The Priest or maybe a Demon. Who are you in this World? Rise up in the rating system by turning your friends into steaming plastic bags with human meat. Get another title.Fight with your own kind. Don't be pathetic! Dominate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/36e1e326df8794ee97c086191885561eddd2e8ed.jpg[/img]

Is this enough to make the game interesting? What do you think about implementing these game mechanics? Maybe you have some ideas that you are ready to share?

notes.title: WHY SINGLE PLAYER BETTER THAN MULTIPLAYER AND MULTIPLAYER BETTER THAN SINGLE?
notes.content:
Why do we play games?

Forget, at least for a while, about the world around us, the people around us and our problems.
Have fun.

There are many reasons, but these two are the most important.

There are two game modes in Morganica - Single and Multiplayer. How do they differ? How are the Player's needs met?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/507c729701314774e938176c3b029219a3c447db.jpg[/img]

[h2]SINGLE PLAYER IS A STORY[/h2]

Plot. An unknown, new, mysterious and frightening World. New friends. Treacherous enemies. Dangerous adventures. Fascinating riddles. The path to victory. Victory!

We have come up with, as it seems to us, a fascinating Story about a gloomy city created by Evil. For four years we have been looking for the right form of expression for it, which will make our Story the most  interesting. We want to tell it in a really fascinating and interesting way. So that no one gets bored.

Innovative game mechanics based on the widespread use of neural network technologies allow us to immerse the Player more deeply into the World we have invented. We are paying lots of attention to this now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/79453f3f59230fabd8f60b7cf56db9dec842147d.jpg[/img]

In a series of subsequent articles, we will tell you more about the plot of Morganica. The adventures that await you. People, monsters and zombies who will become your assistants, reliable friends, treacherous and dangerous enemies.

[h2]MULTIPLAYER - ADRENALINE IN THE COMPANY OF FRIENDS[/h2]

Action with your friends. With people like you. The best cure for loneliness, the biggest problem of our time.

Some of the Founding Fathers of our company grew up on the legendary Doom. Our work was inspired by the legendary Quake 3 Arena. We are both conservative in our preferences and innovative in our approaches. This explains the technical solutions we have chosen, the gameplay and the game mechanics for multiplayer.

Do you want to escape from reality? Launch a game server on your PC and invite your friends. Have a fun time. Run, hide, shoot, rip off each other's heads, turn each other into pieces of steaming meat, kill each other with sophistication and taste. It's so much fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/fc5b49b139834faa403adf624f04d7d6c84d9010.jpg[/img]

No friends? It's familiar. Post the invite on the game's information server and wait. You'll make new friends. From all over the world. Strangers at first. But you can be sure they're just as crazy as you are. Since they have Morganica installed and they came to your call, in some ways you are very similar.

[h2]SUMMARY[/h2]

While playing, we get out of the hateful reality. Morganica will give you this opportunity.

Single Player in Morganica is a fascinating story and adventure. You live a different life in it. With other people. Along with monsters, demons and zombies. There will be many of your new friends and enemies among them. It is interesting.

Multiplayer in Morganica is a bloody action with your real friends. With those who are close to you in spirit, share your views and interests. If there are no such people around you, Morganica will give you the opportunity to find them.

Two different modes. With the same purpose. Based on a single story. This is Morganica.

Help us tell this Story correctly and interestingly. Ask questions. Don't be shy, give us advice. Follow our news. We are doing our best. By the end of this year, we will launch the project on Kickstarter. 

We need your help.

notes.title: PROJECT NEWS. RETHINKING. NEW CONCEPT. KICKSTARTER.
notes.content:
[h2]Year 2021. The birth of the project. A mobile prototype for Quest 2.[/h2]

March 2021. Without a doubt, it was the time of the next heyday of VR technology and the total domination of Oculus Quest 2.
Concept of a new project was formed on the basis of the VR horror story we developed a few years before. The idea of a mobile game in the adventure genre was born, with elements of the action and horror-quest genres. That's how the Morganica was born.
By the end of the year, a prototype for the Quest 2 helmet was created, but in October 2021, everything changed dramatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/412e6c81f01e5a5aed3b69c3add5333e8c44b327.jpg[/img]

[h2]October 2021. Zuckerberg's speech. The concept of metaverses.[/h2]

Mark Zuckerberg's speech at the Facebook Connect conference on October 28, 2021 had a significant impact on the computer game industry, initiating several key changes and trends:

[olist]
[*] The concept of metaverses was formulated.
[*] Everything is so serious that Facebook is becoming Meta.
[*] Explosive growth of interest to VR
[*] Metaverses, VR, bitcoin and NFT are the main trends of that time.
[/olist] 

Then it seemed that all this was for a long time. The gaming market reacted instantly. Everyone seemed to have gone crazy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/528846f358870c898853072ffde63b1a432eae93.jpg[/img]

After Zuckerberg's speech, the term "metaverse" began to be actively discussed in the context of various games such as Fortnite and Roblox. This led to the fact that many gaming companies began to view their projects through the lens of the metaverse, which contributed to the growing interest in this concept.

In response to the growing interest in metaverses, companies such as Epic Games have begun to actively invest in creating their own virtual worlds. For example, Epic Games raised $1 billion to support its vision of the metaverse, which highlighted the seriousness of the intentions of major players in this area.

Mark Zuckerberg's speech became a catalyst for a paradigm shift in the gaming industry, initiating an active discussion and development of the concept of the metaverse. This has influenced companies' investment strategies, approaches to game development, and the creation of new economic models within virtual worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/4d3fd2fdecc4bc53c21c8239ea0a7fb713b109c7.jpg[/img]

What was happening could not but affect the overall concept of Morganica. From a single-player game, the project has transformed into a multiplayer virtual city. The single-player version remained, but turned into a marketing tool to attract attention to multiplayer. VR remained, but as an option. The ability to complete the game and then visit a virtual City using a monitor, keyboard and mouse is very important for expanding the audience.

After a short pause, we started the second version of Project Morganica.

[h2]2022-2023. Working on the demo version.[/h2]

From March 2022 to August 2023, Morganica was finding its new face. As a result, by the end of the summer of 2023, we have almost completed the single-user demo. It was possible to visit the City, learn its history, get acquainted with key characters, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Project. At that time, we were already actively working on social networks. We launched the project page on Steam. We talked with representatives of major gaming companies. We demonstrated our achievements and received feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/9394da976a7d96a77e6bec49830b747060159e8e.jpg[/img]

Based on our communication with representatives of Riot Games and correspondence with one of the founders of a well-known New York venture fund specializing in gaming projects, it was decided to raise the quality of demonstration materials and to develop a new presentation. And first of all, we need a high-quality video. A trailer or a game cinematics. August 2023 was devoted to the adjustment of plans and in early September we started work.

[h2]The year 2024. Cinematics. Neural networks. Realistic view of what is happening.[/h2]

Are you aware that from 2022 to the present day, the share of queries on the topic of generative AI in Google search results has increased by almost 700%? 

The global AI solutions market is expected to grow from $137.7 billion in 2023 to more than $1 trillion by 2030, which corresponds to an average annual growth rate of about 33.8%. 7.5 times growth in seven years!

While working on Morganica Cinematics, we continued to follow trends in the gaming and technology markets. It is obvious that we are experiencing another decline in interest in VR technologies and in general in the metaverse. At the same time, the market is experiencing an explosive growth in the capabilities of generative neural network services. What is happening made us think about the chosen direction of the Project development.

Market analysis. A realistic assessment of the available opportunities and our goals. Calculation of budgets and deadlines required for the implementation of our plans. The emergence of a large number of very useful and effective tools based on AI. New ideas based on the use of neural network services. All this has led to the need to reconsider the concept we have chosen. And we reviewed it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/3f23176815369dbf6a3a43ec4b5226dc1d96daad.jpg[/img]

[h2]Morganica today and tomorrow. Kickstarter.[/h2]

Two modes:
[list]
[*] Singleplayer, with a first-person view, in the horror-adventure genre. It includes action fragments of the Blood Harvest ritual, between which the Player follows the plot of the Game and can take part in additional missions in the horror-quest genre, collecting artifacts and weapons. 
[*] Multiplayer is a Blood Harvest ritual from the storyline single-player version, inspired by the gameplay of the legendary Quake 3 Arena. 
[/list]
And also:
[list]
[*] In-game market for artifacts, weapons, skins and other useful items.
[*] Retention mechanics and procedural generation of combat locations are widely used.
[*] The latest achievements in the field of neural network technologies in the creation of key NPCs.
[*] Two modes - standard and VR.
[/list]

That's what Morganica is today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/06f11508ee954dfc47415776ffd27d947df54c75.jpg[/img]

We are currently working on refining the cinematics. We are working on the basic gameplay. We are launching a new PR campaign for the project on our social networks. We are preparing a website update. The analysis of the new tools is carried out. The necessary staff are being selected for the upcoming pre-production stage. At the end of this year, we plan to launch the project on Kickstarter.

More than ever in these three years, we need questions, advice and comments from our subscribers. Adherents of Morganica. Interested observers of our work.

We hope for your help. Your interest. Your participation.

notes.title: Dynamic gameplay in MORGANICA
notes.content:
[h2]DYNAMIC GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/0d16c4eb5b5191c66d34b666556bb31223ae55d4.jpg[/img]

An important characteristic of the attractiveness of successful game projects is variability - the possible number of options for the development of the game plot, gameplay, in response to certain actions of the Player. 
The variability of the Game directly affects the timing and, accordingly, the cost of its development, which often determines the limitations of the proposed possible options. 

Is there a way out? There is.

[h2]Architecture[/h2]

The Intelligent State Machine (ISM) is a generative neural network.

ISM has complete information about both the Game (virtual) World, stores and uses information about the physical, semantic and cognitive parameters of all game components, and collects and analyzes the current state of the Real World.

By accepting descriptions of their virtual avatars from Players, ISM stores and takes this data into account in the future, when creating their virtual images, forming internal cause-and-effect relationships that determine the current gameplay.

[h2]EXAMPLE OF USING ISM[/h2]

Full moon. The locals, zombies and monsters (NPCs), fall into a poorly controlled aggressive state. Insiders (players) on this day need to be more vigilant and refrain from communicating with the locals.

The day before the events described, insider N3564 (player), exploring a closed area near the barracks of the City Guard (NPC), accidentally seriously injures Colonel Jamid (NPC) (an initially unpredictable event). Reports are spreading through the internal insider network that the Guards have left the city blocks and locked up in their barracks, apparently to clarify the situation and reconnoiter.
The Demons of Evil (NPCs), the former Owners of the City, decide to take advantage of the situation and open a portal through which gangs of Priests (NPCs) enter the City in order to regain power over the City. This becomes known from an emergency appeal from the mayor of the City.

Mayor and the “city self-defense committee” headed by him, calls on all insider clans to take up arms, stand up for protection and clean up their urban areas. Additionally, an urgent recruitment of volunteers is announced for a detachment under the control of armorer Mad (NPC), who goes to the abandoned tunnels of the city subway for rare artifacts that reduce the aggressiveness of local residents, so that they can act as assistants in the liberation of the City from gangs of Priests…

The development of further events is constructed by ISM on the basis of a clear dramatic structure, but its development is constantly adjusted by initially unpredictable events caused by the actions of individual players and the responses of NPCs with their own behavioral patterns embedded in the cognitive agents that control them (D2NCA).

[h2]Сonclusion[/h2]

The above example and its implementation, to date, are still under development. Nevertheless, understanding the existing ways of implementation, the described goals and the tasks at hand, allows us to be confident in the realism of our plans. 
For Players, this means increasing the playability of the project, ensuring an unsurpassed variability of events, and the unpredictability of in-game life.

notes.title: MORGANICA. DISTINCTIVE FEATURES (SELLING POINTS)
notes.content:
For the last three years we have been developing the MMO virtual city Morganica. Its opening is preceded by a single-player computer game of the same name, which tells the story of the City's origin, describes the events that led to free access to it by everyone.

Work on this project has been underway since April 2021. Three years of work on the Project allowed us to take into account the constantly changing features of the gaming and technology markets, better understand the goals and objectives we face, identify difficult moments in its creation, and obtain information for more accurate forecasting.

We’ve started with a mobile VR prototype for the OCULUS QUEST 2 platform, work on which was completed at the end of 2021. Then we passed the prototype stage during 2022-2023. Today we’re working on gaming cinematics. With this experience we came to a better understanding of current realities, concentrated on the PC platform, moved away from being tied to virtual reality (making VR optional mode), and changed the emphasis in our ambitious plans.

The time has not been wasted. At the current stage, we are preparing information materials for potential co-investors, whose involvement is necessary for the implementation of the Project as a whole. Work on cinematics continues. Work is underway on the game documentation. The gameplay is being worked out. It is planned to continue working on an interactive fragment of a future Game or Virtual City.

One of the most important issues we are facing today is the attractiveness of Morganica. What exactly is the difference between our game and others? What exactly should attract the attention of the gaming community to it? What are the selling points of our Project?

1. Relationships with zombies and monsters built on business cooperation and even friendship.

Morganica is primarily a virtual city where players can interact not only with other players, but also with its indigenous inhabitants - zombies and monsters. In Morganica, in most cases, they are not traditional enemies that everyone is used to being afraid of and destroying, it is possible and even necessary to establish business relations with them. This aspect adds a new level of strategy and depth of interaction, making our game unique in its kind. 

2. Widespread use of neural network technologies to control the intelligence of individual NPCs

The current level of development of neural network technologies and observed dynamics of their development allows each NPC to have a unique intelligence. Dynamic gameplay change, in turn, ensures continuous player engagement. The intelligent dynamic transformation of individual locations creates endless possibilities for their exploration.

3. The ability to complete the Game in cinematic mode, watching a single-player Game as an animated movie.

The single-player game, as one of the possible passing options, offers a cinematic mode that allows players to enjoy the game as an animated film. This not only enriches the gaming experience, but also attracts a new audience, including those who may not have time to play the game in the traditional mode. This solution expands the boundaries of virtual gaming, making it accessible and attractive to a wider range of people.

4. Simple controls and graphical interface, which is especially important to attract an audience either far from video games, or who does not have the time / desire to master complex in-game interfaces. 

The simple, intuitive controls and graphical interface make the game ideal for anyone who wants to immediately immerse themselves in the virtual world without wasting time learning complex mechanics. This opens the doors to a virtual city for anyone who wants to join.

5. Commercial activity both within the City and with the possibility of linking it to business in the real world. 

Morganica is not just a gaming space, it is an innovative platform for commercial activities, where everyone can not only develop their business inside the game, but also integrate it with their real business. A unique combination of virtual economy and real entrepreneurship. The bridge between the virtual and the real world makes Morganica not just an entertainment, but also a platform for real entrepreneurship.

6. The possibility of renting or buying real estate in a virtual City.

Renting and buying virtual real estate not only adds a layer of realism and depth to the gameplay, but also opens up new prospects for investment and business development. Participants can acquire, own and manage real estate by creating their own virtual empires that can be linked to real economic goals and strategies. This unique combination of game elements and real economic principles opens up new horizons for players and investors seeking innovation and growth.

7. Simulation of the parameters of a real firearm.

In our virtual city, players can immerse themselves in intense battles using weapons that behave just like in real life. Recoil, reload, accuracy – all weapon parameters modeled with a high degree of realism form an exciting gaming experience that allows players to feel like real fighters.

Realistic firearm simulation adds complexity to the battles, which will attract those who are looking for a more complex and strategic gameplay. This will interest different players and expand the audience of the Game by:
[list]
[*] [b]Fans of military simulators[/b]: This feature will attract those who appreciate the high level of realism in games. They will enjoy the accurate weapon model and tactical capabilities.
[*] [b]Shooting enthusiasts[/b]: Players interested in firearms and shooting will find a unique experience in your Game that matches reality.
[*] [b]Hardcore players[/b]: Realistic weapons.
[*] [b]Streamers and Content Creators[/b]: This feature can attract the attention of streamers who want to showcase their skills in realistic battles.
[/list]

8. Extensive use of game retention mechanics that encourage a return to the World of the Game / Virtual City.

Retention mechanics include an achievement system, personalized tasks, social connections, and competitive elements, thus creating a unique ecosystem that encourages long-term engagement in the gameplay. A virtual City is a place where every visit leaves a desire to return, promising new discoveries and continuous development for both individual players and the entire community.

We strive to develop a game World that will become not just a Game, but a living, constantly evolving virtual world open to everyone. Allowing them not only to immerse themselves in exciting adventures, but also to give them the opportunity to receive real Benefits applicable in the Real World.  Morganika, unlike the existing metaverses, is a world focused on a specific audience, which allows for a more complete level of interactivity and immersiveness. Morganika, if successfully implemented, promises to redefine the virtual worlds of the future.

notes.title: About the characters. The Corpse-Eater.
notes.content:
We continue to write about the characters of the Morganica demo fragment, which will be released on December 25, 2023. We have already talked about Burner, the mysterious prisoner of the Stomad prison and the zombie alcoholic Crazy, whose illness we will learn about in the main game. In the demo fragment, our acquaintance with him will only take place and we will not have time to feel the steady smell of fumes from the never-drying stillborn drunkard. Today we will tell you about the most harmless and at the same time the most nightmarish resident of Morganica.

[h2]The Corpse-Eater.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/b91a34d9f8b1ecc602856d1fdcc04e9c3252e62e.jpg[/img]

The boy was born and began his life quiet and calm. Until the age of two, he grew up, like all the children around him, until someone noticed that the baby began to grow unnaturally fat. The diagnosis was short and deadly. Prader-Willi syndrome. The absence of a copy of the paternal section of chromosome 15 in the genome. But the nightmare was just beginning.

At the age of 20, the boy turned into an insensitive, motionless carcass of human fat and skin. The meaninglessness of existence has become the only thought that has settled in the atrophied brain of a being who once planned to become a man. If the boy could feel something, compare his feelings with something, probably tears would not stop flowing down his flabby cheeks. But only emptiness and a silent scream filled his empty brain.

He did not cause inconvenience to anyone and gradually ceased to care about anyone. Even the wish of death did not disturb the rest of the piece of flesh, which he had turned into by the 20 years of his existence. So he was taken away by the priests of the Demons of Evil, on a windy night in mid-November 1969 from the ward of a private clinic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/c9540c456bdd13d65975b0c3b6a92df67e777d3c.jpg[/img]

What do demons eat? Human emotions. It's on the mental plane. And their physical shell? Human flesh. The designs of Evil are insidious and immeasurably cruel.

The huge body of the former boy became a womb for digesting human remains, generously supplied by the inhabitants of Morganica after each ritual of the Bloody Harvest. Black plastic bags with limbs still moving and fetid offal flowed in an endless stream into the gaping hole of a huge meat grinder. The eternally living intestine, pulsating, fed raw meat and crushed bones into the body, devoid of a head. Right into the torn larynx of a huge carcass, inside which the fermentation of processed human meat was constantly taking place.

Several times a day, the Demons descended into a huge hall, with a body hanging in the center, and sucked the juice out of it for their physical shells. Now the boy and his sick body have found meaning, purpose and name. Now everyone called him the Corpse-Eater.

notes.title: About the characters. Burner.
notes.content:
The demo fragment, which will be released in December this year, will show a very small part of the gameplay and the Morganica game world. There will be only six characters from more than thirty of the original Game. They will try to convey to the players the mood and dynamics of the otherworld. A world full of horror and pain, as well as hope, perseverance and friendship opposing them.

Each of the characters that you will have to meet in the catacombs of the Stomad prison has its own rich history, which cannot be revealed by a short game session. Therefore, we will gradually introduce you to each of them.

[h2][b]Burner[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/11342fb7e15a510b41d437860dbd6044e09d6789.jpg[/img]

Berner, the Insider. One of those unfortunate people who was abducted by the priests of the ancient cult of Demons of Evil, from a European city in the Real World.

He was once a strong, practical man. Life in the City is subordinated to one goal - to experience and sow Terror. But even in such terrible conditions, Berner found his place very quickly. Thanks to his service in the army, he was able to gain the trust of the local arms dealer Mad. This freed him from the universal obligation to participate in the ritual of the Bloody Harvest and made him quite important and influential resident of the City. He was let down by one of the most common sins. Greed.

Succumbing to temptation, he contacted Regan, a local “shadow businessman’, who does not shy away from his usual method of doing business - banditry. At the first attempt to steal and sell a batch of weapons to Regan's monsters, Berner was captured by the Guards. So he ended up in Stomad, a prison that instilled an insurmountable horror in every resident of the City just by hearing about the nightmares going on in it.

The rumors turned out to be true. He was set on fire alive and not allowed to die. For the slaves of the Demons of Evil, whose destiny is to suffer, death is too much luxury. Every day the young man's body writhed in terrible agony. The wild screams of a man whose skin and meat are bursting and charring from the all-pervading flames were heard far beyond the Prison. This went on for many months. No one came to help the traitor. Gradually, the wild screams subsided and one day stopped altogether. Burner became a legend. A creepy, poor inhabitant of the labyrinths of the Stomad prison. There are rumors that the stolen weapon was never found.

notes.title: FIVE TURBULENT MONTHS
notes.content:

notes.title: Future demo fragment of the game
notes.content:
Beginning

 In March 2021, a group of people, united by a common aspiration and many years of experience in the materialization of their imagination, decided to join efforts and start a horror game project. They planned to create the City, opened for everyone to visit, in which people and zombies are fighting for survival, jointly opposing the forces of Evil.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/873c2f4f81889b5206afb5ee0ad2b0f6b6781b88.jpg[/img]

By December 2021, the first VR prototype for the Oculus Quest 2 helmet and a package of game documentation were created, which made it possible to assess the huge potential of the Project and the impressive amount of effort required for its implementation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/41561166ca631db9a1da37a68f1ac4c149a4d519.jpg[/img]

Development

The events of that period in the field of VR technologies and in the gaming market in general made significant adjustments to the plans of the “founding fathers”. In March 2022, work began on the creation of a demo version designed to clarify the goals and objectives of the Project, and to attract the necessary funding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/eef764200cfb0f19441222485865e78771ef608a.jpg[/img]

By the end of July 2023, significant changes were made to the general scenario and lore of the Morganica world, the basic locations and concepts of the main characters of the game were finalized, original game mechanics requiring further implementation were described, the game documentation was completely redesigned, and an action plan for the implementation of the Project was developed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/065288106221bbf25cb8e61e0a680ff182a62c7d.jpg[/img]

These days

On August 1, 2023, the company “SPS Solutions DMCC”, which has sufficient competence and capacity to solve the tasks, was entrusted with the creation of a game demo fragment. Its publication is planned to open in December of this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/253524e31cfd645cd6fb18666961892e08266d0d.jpg[/img]

What awaits the players

1. A game fragment based on the main plot of the Morganica project.
2. A cinematic style of gameplay presentation with the preservation of interactivity and a certain degree of variability of events, usual for computer games.
3. The opportunity to get acquainted with the events described in the game fragment in a fully cinematic mode, while preserving the interactivity of the space surrounding the Viewer.
4. Retention mechanics that make the game fragment, to some extent, unpredictable, encouraging you to go through it again and again, each time discovering something new.
5. First of all, it is planned to implement a PC mode of passing the Game. At the beginning of 2024, a VR mode will be added according to the Open XR standard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/7a6debb03909958c6149c22f5bcc67e41c9cbc4d.jpg[/img]

Goals

 In 2024, the Morganica project should move from the stage of formation and experiments to the stage of full-fledged production. This will be possible thanks to the experience gained, a clear understanding of the goals and objectives formed, attracting the necessary investments and, most importantly, a community of Players who have shown interest in the ideas of the Project, supporting it in wish lists on Steam, comments on its pages on social networks.

Let's wish us all good luck!

notes.title: Planned changes in the visual style and atmosphere of Morganica
notes.content:
We decided that we need to make some locations more creepy, lively and atmospheric, below is a list of proposed changes. All images are current at the time of publication, and do not reflect future changes.

THE LOWER FLOOR OF THE HOSPITAL 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/d156e6e69698c0043bce062273863702619cc459.png[/img]

The light is only from the top floor, through a gap in the ceiling. 

1. Audio-visual effect - dizzy, everything is blurry, auditory hallucinations. Walls and floor with living bodies immured in them. 
2. A certain ghost is rushing (like a blurred figure) around the floor, suddenly appearing for a moment in different places. His movement is accompanied by screams, groans…

NIGHT YARD 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/b1ab19671391bf7d293784b3d4209464be0ea8fc.png[/img]

1. If a gamer looks at one of the windows, a gloomy figure abruptly appears from the darkness of the room, freezes and slowly goes into the darkness. 
2. When a gamer approaches the door in the wall, it closes abruptly and the growling of a feeding monster can be heard behind it. 
3. If a gamer comes close to the wall of the house, one hears a noise from above and a corpse falls from the roof. 
4. A pile of construction debris. A bloody hand is sticking out of it. When gamer comes closer, the hand abruptly disappears into the trash and a dissatisfied growl is heard. 
5. The opening of the garbage chute in the wall. Coming up. Human remains fall out of the garbage chute with a noise. 
6. Balcony jumper (activated when we approach the bar and provided that we look at the balconies). 
7. A group of insiders around a campfire in a barrel. They cannot be approached (blocked by a fallen billboard).

SUBWAY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/1857c775c8112012fa49d9cc92d5e7d3ef2c40be.png[/img]

1. Ceiling beam collapse
2. Hanging and slowly rotating living human remains - clenching and unclenching fingers of severed hands, heads with grimaces of suffering.

THE CORPSE - EATING HALL 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/81cd2aadc3ca1a26a1529d64280ad84ac51155c3.jpg[/img]

1. Human faces with grimaces of suffering in the cracks of the walls, like petrified figures of giants. 

CEMETERY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240533/13ea9b02a4aefb80e2d7ba30d5f46686526afcae.png[/img]

1. A face with grimaces of suffering in the breach in the wall  (building opposite the cemetery) 
2. Fragments of the worm skeleton encircling buildings.
